text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ

words.gloss_range: vocative summons; direct address rather than report
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens the ayah as a direct summons, not a neutral report. It governs the following construct address and fixes the jinn-and-ins pair as the audience for every later second-person plural verb. The lengthened call also gives the challenge a formal launch before the capacity test begins.

topics.headline: direct address launches the challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first fixes its addressees face-to-face before testing their capacity.
topics.reason: The vocative particle and accusative construct address are syntactically forced, and the later second-person verbs route back to this opening summons.

words.gloss_range: accusative vocative collective; an identified assembly or species-community
words.root_gloss_range: association, consorting, and grouped constituency; local noun selects a collective addressee rather than number
words.prose: {{ar:مَعْشَرَ}} ({{tr:maʿshara}}) is the accusative construct head of the address, so the opening noun is the summoned party, not a loose topic. Its construct relation makes the assembly identifiable through the following species labels, while the root field of association makes the addressee a bonded constituency rather than a random crowd. The familiar yā maʿshara address formula has judgment-scene parallels (6:128; 6:130), but here it is redirected into a cosmic escape challenge that later same-surah jinn-and-ins returns keep in view (55:39; 55:56; 55:74).

topics.headline: construct vocative identifies the summoned assembly
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the collective is grammatically summoned and defined by its genitive species labels before any command appears.
topics.reason: Case, construct state, and the following genitive complement all support a vocative construct, not an object or independent topic.

topics.headline: association root forms a species-community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the noun gathers the addressees as a shared community of kind, while local grammar keeps it from becoming a mere numerical or casual-crowd idea.
topics.reason: The root association field survives as collective coloring, while the local noun and genitive species labels select a concrete species-collective.

topics.headline: address formula is redirected to cosmic capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a recognizable accountability address formula is reused for a spatial dare and opens a jinn-ins thread inside the surah.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete formula parallels at 6:128 and 6:130 and same-surah returns at 55:39, 55:56, and 55:74.

words.gloss_range: the definite concealed-being class as first genitive addressee
words.root_gloss_range: concealment, covering, enclosure; local noun selects concealed beings, not garden or shield senses as independent meanings
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجِنِّ}} ({{tr:al-jinni}}) is genitive under the construct address and definite as a known class, making the concealed beings the first named membership group. The root field of concealment remains vivid, but the local noun selects the beings hidden from ordinary perception rather than garden, shield, or fetus branches, and even this hidden class remains inside the same cosmic boundary. Placed before al-insi, the word helps span hidden and manifest intelligent creation, with the same dyad echoed in impossible-task and same-surah scenes (17:88; 55:39; 55:56; 55:74).

topics.headline: definite genitive names the first class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that jinn are not a side topic but the first defined membership class inside the summoned assembly.
topics.reason: The genitive dependency and definiteness make the noun a class label within the vocative construct.

topics.headline: concealment sharpens the hidden addressee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the most hidden addressees are still enclosed by the same cosmic boundary, while derivative garden or shield branches remain only background images.
topics.reason: The root images support hiddenness, but the definite noun locally selects concealed beings rather than other j-n-n derivatives.

topics.headline: jinn-ins pairing makes incapacity comprehensive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recurrent jinn-ins pair turns the challenge into a comprehensive test across concealed and visible intelligent creation.
topics.reason: The inter-ayah rows give concrete dyad parallels and same-surah returns without overriding the local genitive parse.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction joining the second species into the same address
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins the human class to the jinn inside the same vocative construction. Concealed and manifest beings are included with distinction: structurally yoked into one challenge without being collapsed into one name.

topics.headline: one conjunction binds two species into one address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenge is issued to one coordinated pair rather than to two separate audiences.
topics.reason: The conjunction is strongly licensed as coordination between the two genitive species nouns under the same vocative construct.

words.gloss_range: the definite human class as coordinated genitive addressee
words.root_gloss_range: sociability, perception, familiarity, with a noted derivational dispute; local noun selects humans as a class
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْإِنسِ}} ({{tr:al-insi}}) mirrors al-jinni in genitive coordination, so humans stand as equal addressees under the same challenge. Its social and perceivable root pressure contrasts the concealed jinn, but the compact collective form keeps the focus on humankind as a class, not on an individual human. The dyad is familiar across the Qur'an and returns inside the surah (51:56; 55:39; 55:56; 55:74), so the visible human class remains bound to the same boundary test as the hidden one.

topics.headline: humans mirror jinn as equal addressees
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that humans are grammatically equal participants in the cosmic challenge, not an explanatory afterthought.
topics.reason: Shared genitive coordination and definiteness place the human class in parallel with jinn under the same vocative construct.

topics.headline: social visibility contrasts concealed jinn
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the address spans perceivable social humanity and concealed jinn, while the derivational dispute only colors the local class noun.
topics.reason: The local surface root supports sociability and perception beside jinn concealment; the forgetfulness dispute is kept as pressure, not as a replacement for the local noun sense.

topics.headline: familiar pair is turned toward escape containment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar creation and accountability pair is now placed inside a spatial escape test.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete contrasts and same-surah returns, including 51:56 and the later Surah 55 formulas.

words.gloss_range: doubtful conditional opener; if-frame for the challenge
words.prose: {{ar:إِنِ}} ({{tr:ini}}) turns the address into a conditional test. It leaves the possibility grammatically open while marking it as doubtful, and the kasra-linked form carries the particle tightly into istaṭaʿtum. The ayah therefore stages a gate: if capacity exists, the command follows; the later negation and exception define how narrow that gate is.

topics.headline: conditional particle opens a doubtful test
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that impossibility is staged through a live but doubtful condition rather than stated flatly at the start.
topics.reason: The conditional protasis and apodosis are syntactically forced, and the final exception confirms a gated rather than purely absolute framing.

words.gloss_range: if you have capacity; acquired ability assigned to the summoned plural addressees
words.root_gloss_range: obedience, willingness, compliance, and Form X ability; local form selects capacity with compliance coloring
words.prose: {{ar:ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ}} ({{tr:istaṭaʿtum}}) assigns the capacity test to the same plural addressees named in the vocative. As a perfect Form X verb governing an plus tanfudhū, it asks whether they have attained the ability for one precise act, not whether they are merely trying. The root's obedience and willingness field makes ability feel like alignment with the task's order, while the local form keeps capacity as the selected sense; parallels such as 3:97 and 6:35 show ordinary or impossible ability language being stretched here to cosmic scale.

topics.headline: perfect plural capacity governs the penetration complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenge asks about attained capacity for a specific action assigned to the summoned plural audience.
topics.reason: The perfect 2mp verb and its governed complement are syntactically forced and refer back to the vocative addressees.

topics.headline: ability is colored by compliance and alignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ability is not brute force against cosmic order; it is lexically adjacent to compliance, while Form X still selects capacity.
topics.reason: The root field supports obedience and voluntary compliance, but the Form X local verb selects ability or capacity in the conditional frame.

topics.headline: capacity language is scaled to cosmic escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a capacity verb used for bounded feasibility elsewhere is here tested against heavens-and-earth escape.
topics.reason: Concrete parallels at 3:97 and 6:35 support the scale contrast without governing the local parse.

words.gloss_range: subjunctive complementizer; turns penetration into the content of ability
words.prose: {{ar:أَن}} ({{tr:an}}) binds the ability verb to the penetration event. By governing the subjunctive, it turns the following action into the exact content of capacity, so the ayah tests the ability to pass through rather than a vague power claim.

topics.headline: the particle makes penetration the object of capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that capacity is aimed at one precise event: penetrating the cosmic regions.
topics.reason: The complementizer and subjunctive verb form a forced clausal complement of the capacity verb.

words.gloss_range: to penetrate or pass through completely, as governed hypothetical action
words.root_gloss_range: complete passage through, penetration, and operative effect; local context selects full traversal through a boundary
words.prose: {{ar:تَنفُذُوا۟}} ({{tr:tanfudhū}}) is the first n-f-dh verb and appears as governed possibility under an. The root does not mean merely reaching an edge; it asks for complete passage through the cosmic boundary. This first subjunctive begins the ayah's rare three-form spine, moving from possible penetration to command and then to negated fact, with gate-closure contrasts such as 7:40 sharpening the impossibility.

topics.headline: first penetration verb is dependent possibility
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first penetration is grammatically hypothetical and dependent, not already asserted as possible.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect subjunctive after the complementizer inside the conditional protasis.

topics.headline: penetration means complete passage through a boundary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenged act is total traversal of cosmic limits, not touching, approaching, or moving within them.
topics.reason: The local verb plus source-boundary phrase selects full passage through; the 7:40 contrast is useful but does not replace the local syntax.

topics.headline: rare root creates the ayah spine
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this rare root is concentrated in the ayah as a mood-marked drama: hypothesis, dare, factual denial.
topics.reason: All three n-f-dh occurrences are local to this ayah, and the mood sequence is visible across words 9, 16, and 18.

words.gloss_range: from or out through; source/boundary preposition for the escape route
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) attaches the penetration verb to the boundary phrase. It keeps both source and through-pressure alive: the addressees are inside the created order and are challenged to pass out from within its regions. The independent preposition turns abstract denial of favors into a spatial escape test from the cosmos they inhabit.

topics.headline: preposition frames escape from within cosmic regions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenge begins from inside the cosmic enclosure and aims through its boundary, while the exact source-through nuance remains locally bounded by the phrase.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the regions phrase and attaches to the penetration verb; source and passage pressures both fit, but neither becomes a separate lexical topic.

words.gloss_range: regions, extremities, sides, or diameters of the cosmic domain
words.root_gloss_range: spatial side, region, extremity, diameter; homophonous drip or molten-material branches are blocked locally except as distant echo
words.prose: {{ar:أَقْطَارِ}} ({{tr:aqṭāri}}) is the governed construct head that names the cosmic boundary-regions. Its plural and construct form make the route specific to the heavens-and-earth domain, and its edge or diameter range makes the challenge spatial and almost geometric: not one side, but all directions of the perimeter. Material q-ṭ-r branches are not active in the local phrase, though rare-root echoes with 33:14 and 34:12 give the boundary word a marked texture.

topics.headline: regions are governed and defined by the cosmic pair
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the regions are not generic edges but the specified extremities of the heavens-and-earth domain.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive under the preposition and construct before the heavens phrase, with definiteness supplied by annexation.

topics.headline: plural extremities make the perimeter total
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenge concerns multiple cosmic extremities or spans, while the local construction blocks non-spatial material meanings.
topics.reason: Spatial edge, region, and diameter senses fit the min plus penetration frame; drip, tar, or molten-substance senses are blocked by the cosmic construct phrase.

topics.headline: rare boundary vocabulary scales from city sides to cosmos
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a breachable-looking boundary term used for city sides (33:14) is scaled to the whole cosmos here.
topics.reason: The concrete cross-references support boundary resonance and the 34:12 jinn-copper echo remains a thematic echo, not a local sense switch.

words.gloss_range: the definite plural heavens as elevated cosmic domains
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, above-realm, with naming/marking dispute noted; local plural selects elevated realms, not rain
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) is the genitive complement defining whose regions are meant: the known, plural heavens. The elevated-realm sense is selected by aqṭāri, so rainfall or merely name-marking branches are not the local meaning, though the naming dispute sharpens the idea of marked created domains. Paired with earth, the familiar heavens-earth merism becomes an enclosure; 55:29 shows those within it asking God, while 55:33 challenges escape from it, and 55:37 later shows a sky rupture creatures cannot produce.

topics.headline: known plural heavens define the upper boundary domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenged boundary belongs to known elevated, plural heavens, not an unspecified sky or rain-field.
topics.reason: The construct relation and plural definite form select elevated realms; rain and naming disputes are narrowed to background pressure.

topics.headline: dominant merism becomes total enclosure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a familiar heavens-earth formula is made into the total space whose edges are tested.
topics.reason: The heavens and earth are coordinated under the regions phrase, turning a dominant merism into a bounded escape field.

topics.headline: same-surah heavens thread moves from petition to rupture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the heavens phrase sits in a local surah arc: dependence inside the cosmos, attempted escape, then divine rupture.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete same-surah anchors at 55:29, 55:37, and the broader Surah 55 sky/heaven thread.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction completing the heavens-earth pair
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) brings earth into the same governed region-frame as the heavens. It completes the merism while preserving two poles, and it mirrors the earlier conjunction between jinn and ins: two addressee classes face two cosmic domains under one challenge.

topics.headline: second conjunction completes the cosmic merism
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the parallel architecture: a conjunction joins the species pair, then another joins the realm pair.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates earth with the heavens inside the same genitive region phrase and mirrors the earlier species coordination.

words.gloss_range: the definite singular earth as the grounded domain completing the cosmos
words.root_gloss_range: earth, ground, land, settled material domain; local noun selects the total grounded realm
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) closes the merism as the definite singular grounded domain. Its singularity balances the plural heavens, compressing all terrestrial space into one pole of the enclosure. Intertexts such as 41:11 and 55:29 sharpen the contrast: the heaven-and-earth order obeys and depends on God, while the addressees are challenged to escape a structure they cannot leave without warrant.

topics.headline: earth is genitive member of the same governed domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that earth is not an afterthought but the grounded pole included in the same boundary phrase.
topics.reason: The definite singular noun is genitive by coordination with the heavens and completes the governed merism.

topics.headline: grounded earth balances elevated heavens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the challenge spans vertical height and grounded materiality, leaving no escape route above or below.
topics.reason: The earth noun supplies the lower grounded pole opposite the elevated plural heavens.

topics.headline: ordered earth contrasts attempted creature escape
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cosmos being tested as an enclosure is elsewhere the obedient and dependent created order.
topics.reason: Concrete links at 41:11, 55:29, and 14:10 illuminate obedience, dependence, and warrant without changing the local noun sense.

words.gloss_range: consequence particle; then, as apodosis marker before the imperative dare
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) is the hinge from hypothesis to dare. It marks unfudhū as the conditional response, so the command is not free-standing permission but the consequence of the capacity claim: if you can, then do it. Its fused surface with the imperative makes the apodosis land immediately in one compact command beat.

topics.headline: response particle turns condition into command challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the imperative functions as the test of the condition because this particle makes it the apodosis.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the conditional response before an imperative, licensing the dare-function and the immediate pivot from protasis to command.

words.gloss_range: penetrate; a plural imperative functioning as a challenge, not permission
words.root_gloss_range: complete passage through and effective penetration; local imperative uses the root as a performative dare
words.prose: {{ar:ٱنفُذُوا۟}} ({{tr:unfudhū}}) is the whole apodosis command and the middle n-f-dh occurrence. Its imperative form addresses the same jinn-and-ins plural, but the context makes it a taḥaddī: prove the capacity by passing through. The shorter command form compresses the dare between the hypothetical tanfudhū and the factual negation tanfudhūna.

topics.headline: command form performs a challenge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the command is not permission to escape but a dare that exposes inability.
topics.reason: The imperative is the apodosis of the doubtful condition and is immediately followed by negation, supporting challenge force.

topics.headline: single-word apodosis tightens the root sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the middle occurrence turns the earlier hypothesis into a clipped performative command before the root returns under negation.
topics.reason: The apodosis is a single imperative word joined to the response particle, and it mediates the two imperfect forms of the same rare root.

words.gloss_range: not; factual negation of the following indicative, not a prohibition
words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) reverses the dare into factual denial. Because it negates the following indicative, it does not issue a new prohibition; it states that the commanded penetration does not happen. With illā, the denial becomes restrictive: no passage except through the named warrant.

topics.headline: negation turns dare into restrictive denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the decisive turn from try it to you do not, with the exception preserving only one valid route.
topics.reason: The particle independently negates the indicative verb and, with the exception particle, creates the restriction that frames the final phrase.

words.gloss_range: you do not penetrate; indicative factual denial qualified by an exception
words.root_gloss_range: complete penetration or passage through; local final form negates successful passage while allowing one exception
words.prose: {{ar:تَنفُذُونَ}} ({{tr:tanfudhūna}}) is the final n-f-dh verb, now indicative under negation. The returned final nūn and independent clause form give the statement factual weight after the subjunctive possibility and imperative dare. The same full-traversal root is denied as successful passage through the cosmic boundary, but the wording remains gated because illā and bi-sulṭānin follow.

topics.headline: final verb states actual non-penetration
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sequence ends in factual denial, not another hypothesis or command.
topics.reason: The verb is imperfect indicative under negation and retains the same plural addressee.

topics.headline: complete passage is denied except through warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ordinary successful traversal is denied, but the denial is not absolute because it opens toward the sulṭān exception.
topics.reason: The same full-traversal root is negated and immediately qualified by the exception phrase.

topics.headline: third occurrence closes the mood sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the whole ayah argument in one root sequence: possible action, command, then reality stated.
topics.reason: The final occurrence completes the local n-f-dh triptych and binds denial acoustically toward the final tanwīn phrase.

words.gloss_range: except; restriction after negation that isolates the sole valid condition
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) converts the negation into restriction. It does not merely add an afterthought; it assigns the following bi-sulṭānin phrase as the one excluded case from denial. The result is not many possible routes, but a gated possibility: no penetration except by the named warrant.

topics.headline: exception particle makes the denial only-with
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that impossibility is narrowed into an only-with construction rather than left as simple negation.
topics.reason: The exception particle follows negation and assigns the following prepositional phrase as the sole excluded condition.

words.gloss_range: by means of; instrumental preposition attaching sulṭān to penetration
words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) makes the exception instrumental. The ayah does not end with authority or proof as an abstract topic; it says passage would occur by means of sulṭānin. Its fused form in the final phrase makes the means inseparable from the warrant named at the close.

topics.headline: preposition turns sulṭān into operative means
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final condition must function as an enabling means, not merely exist as an idea beside the verb.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the final noun and attaches to the negated penetration verb inside the exception phrase, selecting instrumentality over location or accompaniment.

words.gloss_range: authority, proof, warrant, or empowering capacity as the sole instrumental exception
words.root_gloss_range: power, authority, proof, domination, prevailing warrant; local noun holds authority and proof together as an effective condition
words.prose: {{ar:سُلْطَٰنٍۢ}} ({{tr:sulṭānin}}) is the final word and the object of instrumental bi, not a new subject. Its indefiniteness leaves the qualifying warrant unspecified, while its authority-proof range keeps permission, evidence, and effective empowerment together. The final position resolves the ayah's sequence: summoned addressees, doubtful capacity, terse dare, factual denial, then the one operative warrant that can prevail; echoes where sulṭān is granted or denied for claims, such as 4:153, 12:40, 37:156, 51:38, and 53:23, sharpen that it is not self-generated by jinn or ins.

topics.headline: final noun is the means, not a new actor
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that agency remains with the addressed beings, while the final noun names the required means or warrant.
topics.reason: The noun is genitive after the instrumental preposition inside the exception phrase, closing the syntax as a complement rather than a new clause.

topics.headline: indefiniteness leaves the warrant type unspecified
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah requires a valid warrant without specifying its form, so the exception is real but tightly conditioned.
topics.reason: The noun is indefinite with tanwīn, allowing any qualifying warrant while excluding unwarranted routes.

topics.headline: authority and proof converge as effective warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sulṭān is not passive evidence only or raw force only; it is a warrant that can authorize and prevail.
topics.reason: Classical authority, proof, power, and prevailing branches fit the instrumental exception; local syntax narrows them into one effective warrant condition.

topics.headline: last word resolves the dare-denial sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole ayah lands on the warrant that alone makes the impossible conditionally possible.
topics.reason: The final word position and local sequence make sulṭān the resolution of the summons, condition, command, negation, and exception.

topics.headline: other sulṭān scenes sharpen granted or denied warrant
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Quranic sulṭān can be granted for mission or denied to false claims, so cosmic passage requires authorized proof rather than self-assertion.
topics.reason: Concrete references at 4:153, 12:40, 37:156, 51:38, 53:23, and 55:7 support the warrant field without replacing the local instrumental role.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The threefold ن ف ذ surrounds أقطار السماوات والأرض and ends in the exception بسلطان.
baseline_models.mechanism: Clean passage across the upper-cover/lower-ground totality is challenged, not merely described; practical capacity must become effective, delegated authority for transit.

activation_trace.role: Clean passage to the far side makes the repeated verb the transit operation.
Sides and regions distribute that operation across every cosmic direction.
The overhead sky as covering supplies the upper boundary of the enclosure.
Lower ground opposite the sky closes the vertical totality.
Practical capacity makes the conditional a test of executable means.
Authority and delegated rule define the exceptional means that can legitimate transit.

changed_reading.before: A flat prohibition against spatial escape.
changed_reading.after: A challenge that treats cosmic transit as an operation requiring effective capacity under delegated jurisdiction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated نفذ and the final سلطان can both operate in affairs, statements, proof, and judgment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The verse can stage a jurisdictional test alongside spatial travel: carry an affair or claim through the whole domain if possible, but no claim exits the domain without a proof that overpowers objection.

activation_trace.role: Carrying a command through turns penetration into effective execution.
An outlet from a statement or recourse to a judge supplies the procedural route.
Overpowering proof supplies the warrant that lets the affair go through.
All regions make the challenged jurisdiction comprehensive rather than local.

changed_reading.before: Only bodies attempt to cross a cosmic wall.
changed_reading.after: Claims, commands, or appeals also fail to take effect beyond the comprehensive jurisdiction unless backed by decisive warrant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The vocative addresses one معشر composed of الجن والإنس, while the condition and commands are plural.
baseline_models.mechanism: Hidden and visible orders are convened as one community with a common affair; the challenge tests pooled, coordinated capacity rather than a solitary hero's feat.

activation_trace.role: Kin group or community makes the vocative a corporate summons.
Hidden spirit beings supply the concealed half of the assembled agency.
Visible human presence supplies the manifest half opposed to the hidden.
Mutual compliance supplies the coordination needed by the composite audience.
Working oneself into ability makes capacity something the assembly may try to manufacture.

changed_reading.before: Each creature is individually dared to escape.
changed_reading.after: The entire hidden-visible civilization is challenged to coordinate and produce a shared capacity, yet still lacks independent jurisdiction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet's non-dominant mappings place upward extension and a narrow aperture beside the explicit through-passage and سلطان.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant but anchored reading makes the task channel-specific: stretch upward, locate an unblocked opening, and fit an effective instrument or authority to it rather than dispersing toward any edge.

activation_trace.role: The split target's upward extension gives the attempted capacity a vertical vector.
An unblocked through-passage makes success depend on a corridor.
The split target's narrow entry opening turns the sky-cover into a possible aperture.
A sharp projecting implement supplies the image of a means fitted to penetrate that aperture.

changed_reading.before: Escape means diffuse outward flight in any direction.
changed_reading.after: Passage may be an exacting upward alignment with a particular aperture and a fitted means; the split-root mechanism remains exploratory.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening womb image activates concealment, covering, and outlet in the focus as a birth-like emergence from an encompassing matrix rather than only a prison break.

activation_trace.role: The female womb supplies a containing matrix and activates emergence as the passage mechanism.
The fetus hidden in the womb couples the addressed concealed class to gestational enclosure.
An overhead cover gives that enclosure a cosmic scale.
The outlet supplies the route by which contained life could emerge.

structural_cues: 55:1 opens the packet before the creation sequence and the later focus challenge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies womb, concealment, cover, and outlet; I supply the arrow enclosure -> birth-like emergence. A live alternative is that mercy only frames an otherwise spatial challenge.

changed_reading.before: Penetration is escape from an externally imposed container.
changed_reading.after: Penetration can also be emergence from a sustaining enclosure, possible only by the authority that formed and opens it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Teaching, guiding marks, and disclosure by speech activate the focus's statement-outlet and overpowering proof: knowledge can traverse a domain when it becomes intelligible, warranted communication.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides supplies knowledge as navigational evidence.
Disclosure through speech or sign turns evidence into communicable clarification.
The outlet from a statement or route to judgment receives that disclosed evidence.
Overpowering proof makes warranted disclosure the exceptional passage-enabler.

structural_cues: 55:2-4 pairs teaching the Qur'an with teaching البيان before the measured cosmos is introduced.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies teaching, guiding marks, disclosure, a statement-outlet, and proof; I infer that intelligible warrant can perform a kind of نفاذ. Physical or political authority remains a coexisting alternative.

changed_reading.before: Sultan is mainly force or permission for a body's transit.
changed_reading.after: Sultan can be decisive evidence that lets knowledge, speech, or a claim pass through comprehensive jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Computed celestial motion and repeated balancing activate ordered succession in أقطار: capacity becomes calibration and alignment with an ordered corridor, not undirected power against a wall.

activation_trace.role: Counting and calculation make cosmic motion measurable rather than arbitrary.
Balancing and aligning two things supplies the geometry of a viable crossing.
Ordered succession turns the regions into a sequenced route.
Practical capacity becomes the ability to achieve the required calibration.
Clean through-passage is the result produced when alignment succeeds.

structural_cues: 55:5 gives the luminaries a حساب, and 55:7-9 repeats الميزان, limit, and exact measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies calculation, alignment, succession, and passage; I infer alignment -> corridor access. The live alternative is that the balance sequence is solely ethical and does not specify transit mechanics.

changed_reading.before: Enough raw force could defeat the boundary.
changed_reading.after: The exceptional means may be precise conformity to an already measured order, with misalignment itself preventing passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The recurring paired refrain contains a capacity branch and names lordship; it recasts استطاعة and سلطان as received, governed enablement whose attempted use already displays the giver's sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: Reaching ability or capacity makes the repeated ālāʾ cue echo the focus's استطاعة.
Lordship and sovereignty identify the source and governor of that capacity.
Practical ability is the capacity being tested rather than assumed autonomous.
Delegated authority makes successful agency derivative by definition.

structural_cues: The dual refrain recurs around the focus, with 55:32 immediately before it and 55:34 immediately after it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated ability imagery under lordship and delegated authority; I infer giver -> capacity -> permitted use. The alternative is that the refrain marks gratitude without defining the mechanics of سلطان.

changed_reading.before: Jinn and humans might independently accumulate enough technology or force.
changed_reading.after: Even their accumulated capacity is a bestowed jurisdictional grant, so success would confirm rather than evade sovereignty.

context_deltas.mechanism: Meeting waters, restrained overrun, emergence, and running vessels show a world with productive but governed interfaces; نفاذ is selective throughput across boundaries, not proof that boundaries are absolutely sealed.

activation_trace.role: Mixture and disturbance make the two domains dynamically contact one another.
Two opposed things meeting supplies the interface itself.
Exceeding the limit by aggression distinguishes transgression from permitted contact.
Passing to the outside demonstrates productive output through the interface.
Flowing movement supplies sustained navigation within the governed medium.
Clean passage becomes another case of controlled throughput.
Authority supplies the rule that differentiates licensed passage from overrun.

structural_cues: 55:19-24 stages meeting, a barzakh, non-overrunning, emergence, and ships in sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contact, restraint, output, navigation, and authority; I infer regulated interface -> selective permeability. A live alternative treats the sea sequence as analogy only and the cosmic edge as categorically different.

changed_reading.before: The cosmos is a closed prison with no meaningful openings.
changed_reading.after: The cosmos contains managed interfaces; the issue is not permeability alone but which traffic has warrant to pass.

context_deltas.mechanism: Finite occupants, an enduring sovereign, daily affairs, and directed attention to the two weighty classes shift the attempted transit into evasion of a summons whose jurisdiction outlasts every location.

activation_trace.role: Ending after a period of remaining makes every creaturely location and tenure finite.
Continuance supplies the contrasting permanence of the governing presence.
Directing oneself to an affair turns the following address into a deliberate summons.
Weight opposed to lightness names the two classes as burdened subjects, not free-floating travelers.
Recourse to judgment makes the attempted outlet jurisdictional.
Authority and rule define the jurisdiction the pair cannot outrun.

structural_cues: 55:26-31 moves from universal finitude and continuous divine affairs to direct address of الثقلان immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies finitude, permanence, ongoing affairs, summons, and judicial outlet; I infer spatial flight -> attempted jurisdictional evasion. Physical flight remains part of the rhetoric rather than being cancelled.

changed_reading.before: The question is how far the pair can travel.
changed_reading.after: The deeper question is whether any destination can place finite subjects outside an enduring summons and its authority.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus inventory's molten-copper branch under ق ط ر is activated immediately afterward by flame and copper with aid denied; the abstract directions acquire a hazardous, reactive material face.

activation_trace.role: Molten copper is the surprising focus-side material latent inside the root of أقطار.
Flame without smoke supplies the thermal assault encountered after the attempt.
Reddish copper activates the focus root's molten-metal image across the verse boundary.
Aid and making manifest, explicitly denied in the verse, remove collective rescue from the mechanism.

structural_cues: 55:35 immediately follows the focus and its refrain, pairing fire, nuḥās, and failed mutual aid.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies molten copper under ق ط ر and copper plus flame immediately after; I supply the cross-root arrow directions -> materialized barrier. The live alternative keeps أقطار purely regional and treats the metal echo as accidental branch distance.

changed_reading.before: The edges are neutral coordinates that force alone might cross.
changed_reading.after: The attempted route can materialize as a fire-and-metal interface that reacts against transit and defeats pooled assistance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's non-dominant sky-to-mark mapping is activated when offenders are known by marks, seized at movement-bearing body ends, and made to circulate; escape fails through total legibility and recapture, not wall-thickness alone.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark is the split-root focus image latent beside the heavens.
The same mapped mark now explicitly makes the attempted subjects recognizable.
Capture and imprisonment turn recognition into jurisdictional recapture.
The foot that treads locates capture on the organ of forward travel.
Circling around replaces outward passage with captive recurrence.
Clean transit is the motion reversed by marking, capture, and circulation.

structural_cues: 55:41 identifies by marks and seizes forelocks and feet; 55:44 then replaces outward motion with circulation between two termini.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split mapped mark in السماوات, the same mapped mark at 55:41, capture, feet, and circulation; I infer legibility -> recapture -> no exit. The alternative rejects the split-root activation and retains only punitive imagery.

changed_reading.before: Escape fails because the cosmic shell is too strong.
changed_reading.after: Escape also fails because every trajectory remains marked, knowable, interceptable, and convertible into an orbit inside the jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later concealed gardens, flowing sources, confinement, and another near-but-short layer reverse the vector: سلطان can govern admission into protected abundance as well as attempted egress from judgment.

activation_trace.role: A tree-covered concealed garden is latent in the named jinn root and anchors the alternate destination.
The same concealed-garden branch becomes an explicit protected realm after the judgment sequence.
A source of running water supplies controlled life-giving flow within the enclosure.
Confinement to something makes protected restriction part of the garden's order.
Nearness short of the goal supplies a layered topology rather than a single undifferentiated beyond.
An unblocked outlet can serve entry into a bounded domain as well as exit from one.
Delegated authority functions as an access right across the protected boundary.

structural_cues: 55:46-62 shifts from punishment to paired, bounded gardens with flowing sources and then another spatially ranked pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealed gardens, internal flow, restriction, layering, outlet, and authority; I infer authorized boundary crossing can be ingress. A live alternative reads the gardens only as contrast and leaves 55:33 exclusively about failed egress.

changed_reading.before: All penetration in the focus is an illicit attempt to get out.
changed_reading.after: The same boundary grammar can imply selective admission into protected levels: the issue is authorized crossing, not outward direction alone.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the oil branch of سلطان as a material means rather than a standard gloss. It remains anchored by the focus's سلطان and narrow-aperture split target, then by the sky's opening and oil image at 55:37; downstream prose should label it a cross-branch luminous/lubricating analogy, not replace authority or proof with oil.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The exceptional سلطان stands beside a split-root narrow opening in the heavens.

activation_trace.role: Lighting oil supplies the anomalous focus-side medium or key.
A narrow entry opening supplies the aperture that such a medium might traverse.
Splitting and opening activates the latent aperture after the challenge.
Oil or applied unguent supplies the contextual material echo to سلطان's lighting oil.

changed_reading.before: The exception is only political authority or argumentative proof.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also image an illuminating or lubricating medium fitted to a sky-aperture when the cover ruptures.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The reading is odd because a sharp tongue is a peripheral سلطان branch, yet it remains anchored to the focus's statement-outlet and is activated by البيان. Render it as a rhetorical or speech-act possibility alongside overpowering proof, never as the sole lexical meaning of سلطان.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نفذ offers an outlet from speech or recourse to judgment, and سلطان includes forceful speech.

activation_trace.role: An outlet from a statement makes verbal passage a focus-anchored operation.
A forceful sharp tongue supplies the vocal power that presses the statement through.
Disclosure through speech or sign activates the verbal mechanism from context.

changed_reading.before: Penetration is accomplished by force applied to space.
changed_reading.after: A forceful, clarifying utterance may itself be tested as a passage-making act within judgment and comprehensive address.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it lets a late furnishing miniaturize cosmic geography. It remains weakly anchored by the focus's jinn and regions and by عبقري's coexisting jinn-place and patterned-carpet branches; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for folded or represented space, not as an asserted destination.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins hidden beings to the regions of an encompassing cosmos.

activation_trace.role: Hidden spirit beings anchor the concealed side of the imagined geography.
Sides and regions supply the spatial pattern potentially represented in miniature.
A place of jinn and wonder reconnects the late material scene to the focus audience.
Fine patterned carpets supply the surface on which that hidden geography can be materially figured.

changed_reading.before: Cosmic regions are only vast external coordinates.
changed_reading.after: Very exploratorily, hidden geography can be folded into a patterned surface, making penetration a change of represented layer rather than sheer distance.

strongest_changes: The apparent sealed wall became a system of measured, managed interfaces whose traffic depends on warrant.
Autonomous ability became bestowed and delegated capacity under the sovereignty repeated around the focus.
Spatial escape acquired coexisting legal, epistemic, and summons-evading readings through نفذ and سلطان.
Later marking, capture, and circulation made failed escape a problem of total legibility and recapture, while the gardens preserved authorized ingress as the reverse vector.
summary.what_was_special: The repeated نفذ, the three-way split mapping of السماوات, the non-dominant upward mapping under استطاعة, and immediate copper/oil/mark echoes produced several live mechanisms that a single escape paraphrase would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether force, delegated rule, proof, and speech under سلطان are alternatives, cumulative requirements, or deliberately unresolved.
Whether the molten-copper, oil-aperture, and sky-to-mark activations are intended cross-root resonances or productive but distant packet effects.
Whether the later gardens genuinely reverse the focus toward authorized ingress or only contrast reward with failed egress.
How much weight the form-distant split mappings should bear without losing their discovery value.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Penetration as passage through a bounded structure.** Repeated `ن ف ذ/B001` gives piercing through to the other side; `ن ف ذ/B003` gives an open outlet. The repeated challenge, the cosmic edges, and the exception supply a boundary experiment. I infer that the realms are structured enclosures, not indefinite space. The ayah reads as testing for a legitimate passage.
2. **Authority or proof as the enabling condition.** `س ل ط/B002` supplies overpowering proof and `س ل ط/B003` delegated authority. These remain distinct readings: passage may require a valid warrant, or an effective power conferred to act. The packet supplies the exception; I supply the arrow that authorization opens what ability alone cannot.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:35 resolves the counterfactual attempt with forces that block self-directed escape. 55:50 and 55:66 later provide flowing and gushing openings inside the gardens, suggesting access is given internally rather than seized across outer limits.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **`ع ش ر` `B013` — “community or class,” `ط و ع` `B003` — “ability,” `ن ف ذ` `B001` — “pass through,” and `ق ط ر` `B001` — “sides or regions.”** Structural cue: a collective vocative opens a conditional whose root verb is repeated in condition, imperative response, and final negation. Assigned role: the construction grants the thought-experiment of coordinated ability, then encloses it within cosmic regions and a stated condition. Packet evidence is the repeated morphology and spatial noun. Inference: even aggregate human-jinn capacity cannot convert imagined passage into autonomous escape. Reading change: the ayah tests a whole class’s effective reach, not merely individual travel.

2. **`س ل ط` `B001` / `B002` / `B003` — “coercive force,” “proof or warrant,” and “authority.”** Structural cue: all three viable images occupy the restrictive `إِلَّا بِـ` slot. Assigned role: `B001` makes passage require effective force, `B002` makes it require a valid warrant, and `B003` makes it require authorization; these alternatives coexist without being merged. Packet evidence is the branch inventory and exclusivity construction. Inference: successful penetration, if conceived at all, depends on power or license not generated by the challenged group itself. Reading change: `سُلْطَٰن` can regulate legitimacy as well as raw capability.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 55:35 especially strengthened `س ل ط B001`, since dispatched blaze and `نُحَاس` instantiate effective force; it did not eliminate the warrant or authority alternatives.

baseline.text: Ey cinler ve insanlar topluluğu göklerin ve yerin sınırlarından geçip gitmeye gücünüz yetiyorsa geçin bir güç olmadan geçemezsiniz

findings.text: Tekrarlanan geçiş çağrısı, gökleri ve yeri çıkışı ancak belirli bir şartla mümkün olan yapılı sınırlar olarak gösterir.
İnsan ve cin topluluklarının birleşik yeteneği bile kendi başına bu sınırları aşan bağımsız bir kaçış üretemez.
Geçiş için gereken güç, kaba kuvvetten farklı olarak geçerli bir kanıt veya haklılık belgesi anlamına da gelebilir.
Geçiş, topluluğun kendi kendine verdiği güçten değil, dışarıdan tanınan bir yetkiden kaynaklanabilir.
Sonraki ateşli engelleme, gerekli gücün fiilen etkili olan üstün kuvvet anlamını da belirginleştirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kırılarak ayrılmış parçaları çekirdek alır, fakat kesilmiş hayvan paylarını, herhangi bir parçayı ve her yana dağılmış toplulukları da aynı dalda toplar. Dal kullanılabilir; fiziksel kırık parça, bölüşüm payı ve dağılma uzantıları birbirine özdeş sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek bütünden ayrılan parçalardır; paylar ve dağılmış insan kümeleri bu çekirdeğin bağımlı uzantılarıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın parça biçimlerini, kırık çömlek kalıbını ve dağılma biçimini ayrı yüzlerde tutar; kalıp anlamı bütüne yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir bütünün kırılma ya da ayırma sonucunda parçalara ayrılmasıdır; bu parçalar pay olarak bölüştürülebilir, insan topluluklarına aktarıldığında ise her yana dağılmış kümeleri anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Kap veya benzeri bir bütün kırılarak ayrı parçalara dönüşür.
Ayrılmış bölümler, kesilmiş bir hayvanın bölüşüm paylarını da gösterebilir.
Parçalanma görüntüsü insanlara aktarılarak her yöne dağılmış kümeleri anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı kırık kap parçalarını, bölüşülen payları, herhangi bir şeyden ayrılan parçayı ve farklı yönlere dağılan insan kümelerini tek bir ayrılma görüntüsü çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: parçalara, paylara veya dağınık kümelere ayrılma
concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel kırılma çekirdeği ile pay ve dağılmış topluluk uzantılarını birlikte göstermek gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kırık parçayı, ayrılmış payı ve dağılmış küme uzantısını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kabın veya başka bir nesnenin kırık durumunu niteleyen cümlelerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Fiziksel bütünün kırık ve ayrı parçalara dönüşmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bölüşüm paylarını ve her yöne dağılmış insan kümelerini kapsamaz.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan topluluklarının farklı yönlere ayrılmasını anlatan cümlelerde uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Fiziksel kırık parça ve bölüşüm payı anlamlarını kapsamaz.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Fiziksel kırık parça çekirdeği örtüşür; odak dal paylara ve dağılmış topluluklara uzanırken komşu dal küçük kırıntı türlerine yoğunlaşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir nesnenin uzunluğunun tam on arşına ulaşmasını tek ve açık ölçü koşulu olarak verir. Dal çerçevesi nesne türü eklemeden bu sabit uzunluğu doğru yansıtır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki söz biçimini de Muharrem ayının onuncu günü için ad olarak verir. Dal çerçevesi takvim gününü, ayı ve sıra sayısını eksiksiz korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca Muharrem ayının onuncu gününü gösterir; genel onuncu gün veya deve sulama günü değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, iki yalın gün adını aynı takvim gününe bağlar ve başka ay ya da hafta günü anlamı eklemez.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar iki biçimin de aynı takvim gününü, Muharrem ayının onuncu gününü adlandırdığını bildirir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi birlikte bulunma, yakın ilişki kurma ve hayatı paylaşma çekirdeğinden eş ya da yakın ilişki kurulan kişi adına uzanır. Dal çerçevesi ilişkiyi ve katılımcı adını birbirine bağlı fakat ayrı görünümler olarak doğru sunar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal kişiler arası yakın ilişki ve birlikte yaşamadır; akraba topluluğu, kabile veya yalnızca evli olma durumu değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın ilişki, karşılıklı birlikte yaşama ve ilişki kurulan kişi anlamlarını kapsar; belirli bir kalıba bağımlı değildir.

facets.statement: İki ya da daha çok kişi yakın ilişki kurar ve hayatı birlikte paylaşır.
Yakın ilişki kurulan kimse, özellikle eş, bu ilişki üzerinden adlandırılır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Birlikte bulunmanın yanında iç yüzü bilme, eşlerin bedensel yakınlığı ve belirli süreli beraberliği de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişiler arasında yakınlık, birlikte bulunma ve eş ilişkisi bağlamlarını kapsayabilir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişinin dayanıştığı yakın ailesi veya kabilesini temel alırken, ortak işi olan herhangi bir topluluğu da daha geniş bir adla kapsar. Dal korunabilir, ancak soy bağına dayalı topluluk ile yalnızca ortak amaçta birleşen topluluk aynı sınırda tanımlanmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek kişinin ailesi ve yakın akraba topluluğudur; ortak işi olan daha genel topluluk bunun kapsam uzantısıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın akraba topluluğu ile ortak işte birleşen genel topluluk biçimlerini iki ayrı yüz olarak korur.

facets.statement: Kişinin ailesi, yakın akrabaları veya kabilesi birbirine bağlı bir topluluk oluşturur.
Ad, üyeleri ortak bir iş veya amaçta birleşen daha genel topluluklara genişler.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ay gecelerini üçlü kümelerle adlandıran özel dizgede, dokuz diye adlandırılan üç geceden sonra gelen üç geceyi gösterir. Aynı tek kaynak bu adlandırma dizgesinin geneline itiraz edildiğini de kaydeder; anlam bu sınırlı ve tartışmalı kullanım olarak korunmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal herhangi on geceyi değil, ay içindeki dokuzlu gecelerden sonraki özel üç gecelik kümeyi gösterir ve tek kaynakla sınırlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın gece kümesi adını verir, ancak onu genel on sayısına veya ayın herhangi üç gecesine genişletmez.

facets.statement: Ay içindeki üç gecelik küme, dokuzlu diye adlandırılan önceki üç gecenin ardından gelir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalı örtme, duyulardan gizleme ve bir örtünün arkasına saklanma çekirdeğinde kurar; içte saklama ile insanı örten giysi de bu çekirdeğin açık gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca örtme ve gizlenme alanındadır; akıl yitimi, bahçe ve görünmeyen varlık anlamlarını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalı kapsar ve başka dallara ya da yalnızca belirli bir söz öbeğine bağlı anlamları içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi duyuların erişiminden çıkaracak biçimde örtmek ya da gizlemek; kişinin bir şeyin arkasına saklanması, bir şeyi içinde saklaması ve insanı örten giysi bu çekirdeğin gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir şey örtülerek ya da gizlenerek duyuların erişiminden çıkarılır.
Bir örtünün arkasına saklanma, bir şeyi içinde saklama ve insanı örten giysi aynı gizleme çekirdeğine dayanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak ekseni, bir şeyi duyusal algıdan örterek gizlemek ve bu örtünün sağladığı saklılık durumudur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin örtülmesini, bir kişinin saklanmasını veya örtü işlevli bir şeyi birlikte temsil eden en geniş karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Örtme işlemini, duyulardan gizlenme sonucunu ve dalın genel kapsamını korur.
